content: Simple inventory apps commonly conflate manual adjustments (corrections) with operational deductions (daily usage) in one quantity field without an audit ledger, losing the ability to diagnose drift; negative balances then mask unrecorded events. Days-of-supply (on-hand / average daily usage) is more actionable than raw counts or percentages for low-stock warnings; reorder point = daily demand x lead time + safety stock. Based on inventory management practice; search was rate-limited so treat as design principle, LOW-MEDIUM confidence.
